title: Loved but-
text:
Loved but-. I paid full price (then saw clearance set = :~O) Packed super well - good thing - came USPS. :~/
Lrg cansiter still had flour dust inside, seal off but near by. (I could not get it on.) One had water spots all over. Set was rustic - between al this I am returning them. Lids did fit TIGHT as reviewed. Being wood - they could be sanded smaller.
